crossRefs.note: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…
He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to…
You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
and gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;
even a heritage to Israel his servant; for his loving kindness endures forever:
So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to…
So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.
Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with…
“ ‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them…
I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of…
Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land…
It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to…
and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and…
They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same…
Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

translations.web: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
translations.bsb: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
translations.kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
translations.asv: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:
